x: The usual conditions were in force and two men were allowed in each event from each club, no man being allowed to turn out twice in the evening. 18 points were allocated to the winner's club, 17 points to second, and so on, downwards, in each event. The first race was at five miles and Redman (Metropolitan W.C.) and A.
… for our three scoring men. At 18¾ miles M.W.C. led us 16—22; the Whitlock brothers being 1st and 3rd, their third man, Redman, having dropped to 10th.…
Harry Churcher was disqualified in the last two miles of the race, Redman thus having an easy win. The handicap team race was won by Metropolitan W.C., our "B" team being second and "A" team third.
